memory: wire disabled context injection boundary into message AI request

Wire the disabled-by-default message context injection boundary into the normal message AI request path.

This keeps context injection disabled, preserves current prompts, and passes contextInjection metadata for future diagnostics without connecting DB/storage or touching transport, Render, GitHub tools, permissions, or OpenAI client logic.
